nodes.label: skin condition type
nodes.description: The type of skin condition (e.g., rosacea, sensitive skin, acne-prone).

nodes.label: ingredient sensitivity
nodes.description: Sensitivity to certain ingredients like fragrances or plant extracts.

nodes.label: product formulation
nodes.description: The composition and structure of the product (e.g., gel, cream, serum).

nodes.label: application method
nodes.description: How the product is applied (e.g., morning/night routine, step-by-step system).

nodes.label: sun protection
nodes.description: Protection from UV damage, especially important for redness-prone skin.

nodes.label: targeted treatment
nodes.description: Specific ingredients or methods aimed at reducing redness.

nodes.label: skin type compatibility

nodes.label: brand reputation
nodes.description: The trustworthiness and track record of the brand.

nodes.label: price range
nodes.description: The cost of the product or system.

nodes.label: user experience
nodes.description: The overall satisfaction and ease of use reported by users.
